def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    ptr = 0
    n = int(input[ptr])
    ptr += 1
    a1, a2, a3 = map(int, input[ptr:ptr+3])
    ptr += 3
    b1, b2, b3 = map(int, input[ptr:ptr+3])

    min_wins = min(a3, b1) + min(a1, b2) + min(a2, b3)
    max_wins = min(a3, b1) + min(a1, b2) + min(a2, b3) + max(0, n - (b1 + b2 + b3) - (min(a3, b1) + min(a1, b2) + min(a2, b3)))
    print(min_wins, max_wins)

main()
